data.title: CP AXTRA posts H1 2026 revenue of B268.33bn, online sales up 29%
data.description: CP AXTRA Public Company Limited (The Company or CPAXT), the operator of “Makro and Lotus’s,” Store transformation lifts mall occupancy by 4% announced its operating results for the first half of 2026, with total revenue of 268,334 million baht, an increase of 3.6% year-on-year. Online sales via the Makro PRO platform and Lotus’s SMART App grew more than 29%, Store transformation lifts mall occupancy by 4% and out-of-store sales continued to expand, underscoring the strength of the Company’s omnichannel strategy. The Company also advanced its “Happy & Healthy Mall” strategy, raising mall occupancy rates, particularly at newly transformed locations. Together, these results mark a new milestone in enhancing customer experience by seamlessly connecting the three core pillars of the Company’s Retail Ecosystem: online channels, physical stores and shopping mall spaces.

data.title: Ovagen Peptide: Reproductive Signaling, Cellular Communication, and Emerging Research Directions
data.description: The expanding landscape of peptide-based inquiry has introduced a variety of short-chain bioactive molecules whose roles are believed to extend into highly specialized signaling domains. Among these, the Ovagen peptide occupies an intriguing conceptual space, often discussed in connection with reproductive signaling pathways, cellular differentiation, and endocrine modulation. While its precise biochemical identity remains somewhat ambiguously defined in mainstream literature, Ovagen is generally described as a peptide complex or derivative associated with ovarian tissue extracts or reproductive signaling fractions. Its relevance in experimental frameworks has increasingly drawn attention, particularly where subtle regulatory processes intersect with peptide-mediated communication.

data.title: TFM Posts Strong Q2 Growth, Declares THB 0.18 Interim Dividend
data.description: BANGKOK – 31 July 2026 – Thai Union Feedmill Public Company Limited, or TFM, reported strong operating results for the second quarter of 2026, with revenue increasing by 9.8% and net profit rising by 9.0% from the previous quarter. data.title: TCMA and GIZ push low-carbon technologies to drive cement sector toward Net Zero 2050
data.description: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) has expanded its partnership with Germany’s development agency, the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ), to accelerate the adoption of low-carbon technologies in Thailand’s cement industry. The initiative, highlighted at the TCMA xGIZ at TCMA Technical Conference 2026, reflects a shift from policy commitments to implementation, under the theme: “#MadeInGermany: Cement Decarbonisation in Practice – Insights for Thailand”. The collaboration aims to transfer proven technologies and expertise from developed economies to support Thailand’s transition toward Net Zero emissions by 2050.

data.title: Risk-On or Risk-Off? How to Read Global Sentiment Before You Trade
data.description: Financial markets are not only affected by economic indicators and corporate performance but also by the sentiments of investors. Every day in trading markets, people decide whether they want to seek risk or avoid it. This is called risk-on and risk-off sentiment.

data.title: Central Bank Policy: Its Impact on the Currency Market
data.description: Central banks have an important influence on the foreign exchange market. Decisions regarding interest rates, policy statements, inflation projections and economic growth all influence the value of currencies relative to one another. In the forex market, understanding central bank policy is vital, as it is often the primary driver of currency movements.

data.title: Inflation Is Back: What the Next CPI Release Means for Traders
data.description: One theme that is making its return to the global financial markets is that of inflation. Following a long period during which there has been relative calm on the inflation front, rising pressures from commodity prices have forced traders to look at the prospects for inflation, central bank policy, and market conditions once again.
